description: Common enums and other schemas used with requests or datasets.

DatasetTypeEnum.description: Main type of a response (dataset) object. Also used in requests. TMY and LONG-TERM AVERAGE datasets have 'non-real' timestamps (not representing real instances of time). TIMESERIES datasets have timestamps with the real meaning.

DataOriginEnum.description: Origin of data values in single column or in the whole dataset.

TimeAlignmentEnum.description: Datetime strings (labels of time intervals) can represent start, center or end of the time interval (or the left edge, the center and the right edge of the time interval).

TimeStepEnum.description: Time step of the datetime column, also known as time resolution or time granularity.
TimeStepEnum.$comment: Values use ISO 8601 durations standard from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations with few limitations: not supported week W designator and fractions like P0.5Y.

SolarRadiationColumnTypesEnum.description: Column types from the solar data domain. Including also tilted solar irradiation types.
SolarRadiationColumnTypesEnum.$comment: Do not confuse column types with column names, but prefer using type names for column names if applicable (when creating datasets).

EnergySystemColumnTypesEnum.description: Column types from the various energy systems - photovoltaic or wind turbines.

MeteoColumnTypesEnum.description: Column types from the meteorological data domain.

UncertaintyColumnTypesEnum.description: Special type for uncertainty columns e.g., PVOUT_UNC_P25, GHI_UNC_P75 - can occur in datasets, but cannot be requested as names in requests.

OtherColumnTypesEnum.description: Following column types can occur in dataset metadata, but cannot be requested as names in Solargis requests.

AllColumnTypes.description: Merging all possible column types together. Used only in the response (datasets).

SolargisSpecialColumnNamesEnum.description: In addition to the most of the column type names, Solargis also recognizes the following column names in the request.

SolargisWindHeightColumnNamesPattern.description: Solargis recognizes a pattern for two wind column names. Wind speed and wind direction can be recorded at the predefined height range above the ground (from 50 to 200 meters).

SolargisUncertaintyColumnNamesPattern.description: Solargis recognizes the names of several uncertainty scenarios for selected column types.

RequestColumnNames.description: Solargis recognizes these column names in the request.

SolarRadiationUnitsEnum.description: Units used with solar radiation data - either power or energy.

TemperatureUnitsEnum.description: Units used with the temperature of air, panel surface or a device temperature.

WindSpeedUnitsEnum.description: Units used with wind speed data.

AngularUnitsEnum.description: Various angles - used in wind direction, solar geometry, panels, etc.
AngularUnitsEnum.$comments: deg_azimuth_from_north_clockwise: from  0 to 360 degrees, deg_aspect_from_south_both_directions: 0 South, -90 East, 90 West, -180/180 North.

PressureUnitsEnum.description: Units used with the air pressure.

PrecipitationUnitsEnum.description: Units used with water vapour, rain, snow and atmospheric pollution.

AllUnits.description: Convenience schema - merging all possible units.

QualityControlStepEnum.description: Identifier of a QC check step.

QualityControlPlatformEnum.description: Platform or system that executed a QC step.

ColumnQualityEnum.description: Types of the data quality and maintenance quality of the column.

ValidationPriorityEnum.description: Types of the validation priority of the column.

VentilationHeatingEnum.description: HVAC - heating, ventilation, air conditioning of the instrument.

ShadingTechnologyEnum.description: Shading technology used with the instrument.

LandscapeRepresentativenessEnum.description: Degree to which the site's local landscape represents the broader surrounding region for the measured variable.

SurroundingsEnum.description: Classification of the immediate surroundings of the instrument in terms of obstructions and nearby heat sources that could affect measurements.

PhotodocumentationEnum.description: Availability of photographic documentation of the site and instrument installation.

ComparisonModelTypeEnum.description: Source of the Solargis model data used for comparison against measurements in the report.

PublishingEnum.description: Enum for rules what information may be published - nothing, location only, validation statistics, etc.
